assumptions: Independent 70 km V3 entry scenario. Initial position estimated against the existing physics and controls. The modeled chapter supports a two-pin tower catch. A miss can divert to a landing. SpaceX did not publish the state used here. The default chapter enters with a 12 % main-tank fill and flies the legacy powered descent. Its seed was moved 500 m downrange and 74 m north on 2026-11-24 when the V3 forward flaps took their measured ogive geometry, which shifted the glide footprint about 500 m short; it then catches again at 50, 60 and 120 Hz (CAPTURE_MENU_MODAL=flight15catchverify). The singleBurn block (EXOSPHERE_SINGLE_BURN_CATCH=1) enters at 215 t, the single-burn bench mass, because the flown catch used one 18 s landing burn instead of a long powered descent; its seed is recalibrated for that lighter belly flop.
